assets.description: 小演员背对同伴，已经把船放回箱子。本组视角和大小一致。与课堂画的构图不同。 Two early-grade children. Apricot-sweater short-haired child has turned their back to the pine-green-pinafore friend, clearly placing the small yellow origami paper boat into an open low box. No asking gesture.

小演员面向同伴，指向桌边够不到的纸船。本组视角和大小一致。与课堂画的构图不同。 Two early-grade children. The short-haired apricot-sweater child is turned to face the pine-green-pinafore friend, eyes on the friend with open asking mouth, arm pointing to a yellow folded paper boat still on the far side of the table. Nobody has touched the boat. Both friend and boat distinct.

小演员已接过同伴递来的船，双手在胸前致谢。本组视角和大小一致。与课堂画的构图不同。 The same two children face each other. The apricot-sweater child holds the yellow origami boat already received, with both hands up near the chest and a grateful smile. The pine-green-pinafore friend has released it. There is no pointing.

同样形状的鲜红色布灯笼。本组视角和大小一致。与课堂画的构图不同。 One large fully red scarlet ROUND FABRIC hanging lantern. Short same-color fringe, one small neutral hanging cord. EXACT same silhouette, scale and brightness as other two lantern cards, with vivid true red body.
同样形状的松绿色布灯笼。本组视角和大小一致。与课堂画的构图不同。 One large fully pine GREEN ROUND FABRIC hanging lantern. Same silhouette and scale as the RED lantern in column 1, same fringe and neutral cord. No red marks.

同样形状的雪白色布灯笼。本组视角和大小一致。与课堂画的构图不同。 One large fully snow-WHITE ROUND FABRIC hanging lantern. Same silhouette and scale as columns 1 and 2, same fringe and neutral cord. A subtle cool-gray shadow distinguishes white from the cream background.

棉花姑娘低头，垂叶有小蚜虫。本组视角和大小一致。与课堂画的构图不同。 New closer composition of a shy personified cotton paper puppet with pale apricot human face, bowed stem, unmistakably DROOPING cotton leaves and several small bright yellow-green oval aphids ON one drooping leaf. No white cotton bolls on branches. No other actor.

绿叶展开，枝头洁白棉花露出来，棉花姑娘笑。本组视角和大小一致。与课堂画的构图不同。 New closer composition of same cotton paper puppet smiling, sturdy upright stem and bright green UPWARD leaves. Distinct fluffy white cotton bolls clearly visible at the ends of two branches. No insect. A different pose from teaching art.
一个满是稻苗的水田，青蛙在水边，不出现棉花姑娘。本组视角和大小一致。与课堂画的构图不同。 Large patch of obviously green rice seedlings with water, plus a green frog sitting at the edge. No person, no cotton leaves, no white cotton bolls.
